bindings.handoff: Draft user-flow questions and a UX state inventory for product clarification.
bindings.approvalBoundary: The Discipline contribution drafts guidance only; requirements approval and PDLC state remain outside the Discipline Agent.

bindings.handoff: Draft a reviewable UX specification and textual mockup proposal for product review.
bindings.approvalBoundary: The Discipline contribution drafts guidance only; product approval and PDLC state remain outside the Discipline Agent.

bindings.handoff: Implement the approved UX state matrix in existing React conventions and report focused test evidence.
bindings.approvalBoundary: The Discipline Agent may edit scoped React UI code and tests but cannot approve requirements, gates, or PDLC state.

bindings.handoff: Run the smallest relevant existing test and report evidence for the approved React UI behavior.
bindings.approvalBoundary: The Discipline Agent reports verification evidence only; PDLC acceptance, gates, and state remain outside the Discipline contribution.

bindings.handoff: Review the delivered UX against supplied acceptance criteria and report evidence-backed findings.
bindings.approvalBoundary: The Discipline Agent reports findings only; PDLC acceptance, gates, and state remain outside the Discipline contribution.
